items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: His Daddy was a cigar maker, rolled cigars, you know? Little fellow.

ctx.x: That's right. I used to go down there go to Emil, you know, go down to their house, little bitty fellow, and Barney be setting around there. His Daddy was a
